senses.gloss: (cmp. זהם) [to glisten,] to be fat, greasy, filthy.—Part. Polel זוֹמֵם.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 152b:7">Sabb. 152ᵇ</cite> (where the souls of the righteous are compared to clean, and those of the wicked to filthy garments) <he>ושל רשעים זוֹמְמוֹת והולכותּ</he> while the souls of the wicked are getting more and more greasy.
